# fortiappseccloud_waf_template_request_limits

Configures request limits for one FortiAppSec Cloud WAF template using the static template endpoint `/waf/template/{template_id}/request_limits`. This resource owns the template's module settings. To make an application inherit them, configure the matching app module resource with `template = true` and omit its `configs` block.

Declare only one `fortiappseccloud_waf_template_request_limits` resource for a WAF template.

## Example Usage

```hcl
resource "fortiappseccloud_waf_template_request_limits" "example" {
  template_id = fortiappseccloud_waf_template.example.template_id

  configs {
    status              = true
    body_param_len      = 8192
    cookie_num          = 128
    http_req_len        = 2048
    malformed_url_check = true
    range_num           = 5
    http_header_action  = "alert_deny"

    # Omit this ownership wrapper to preserve the complete remote allow_methods
    # array. Keep the wrapper but remove every item block to explicitly send [].
    allow_methods {
      item { method = "get" }
      item { method = "post" }
      item { method = "head" }
    }
  }
}
```

## Argument Reference

- `template_id` (Required, Forces replacement) — WAF template ID.
- `configs` (Required) — Typed request limits configuration. Its attributes and ownership-wrapper blocks are identical to `fortiappseccloud_waf_request_limits` when that app resource uses `template = false`.

## Import

Import using the template ID:

```shell
terraform import fortiappseccloud_waf_template_request_limits.example TEMPLATE_ID
```

The first read after import hydrates all supported ownership wrappers.

## Destroy Behavior
Destroy performs a fresh GET, preserves the complete response, sets `template=false` and `configs.status=false`, sends the complete PUT, and verifies the normalized GET response before Terraform removes the resource from state.
